properties.name: 15/04189/FUL
properties.site-address: Lock Up Garage Site May Street/lower Brook Street Brookvale Basingstoke
properties.notes: Full planning permission (15/04189/FUL) was granted in March 2017 for 12 affordable units. The site has been sold by the council and the new owners Sovereign have indicated that they are due to commence on site in September 2017 with completions expected in July 2018.. Erection of 12 no. dwellings to provide affordable housing (4 no. 1-bed flats & 8 no. 2-bed houses) with associated parking and landscaping following demolition of existing lock-up garages
